context: A boss and his manager dissect a long-form documentary article
purpose: Teach: 亡命/損傷/神聖/考古学/試練/畜産/粒子/仮名

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: この記事、亡命科学者の話、面白いな。
lines.en: This piece on exiled scientists is interesting.
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured opening. Light emphasis on the topic. Calm, observant — reading as he speaks. Pause before the period, like he's genuinely considering.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。畜産から考古学まで、研究領域は多岐にわたります。
lines.en: Yes. Their research spans from livestock to archaeology.
lines.style: Formal but not stiff. Slight uptick on the breadth — acknowledging complexity. Clear enunciation. Respectful pause before expanding on the scope.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 発掘現場での損傷、神聖な遺物まで及んでいるな。
lines.en: On-site damage reaches even sacred relics.
lines.style: Firmer, more direct. Weight on 'even' — the gravity of the scope sinking in. Composed but not distant. A moment of intake, then the observation lands.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 粒子分析で復元を試みているチームもあります。技術的な試練、大きいそうです。
lines.en: Some teams are attempting restoration through particle analysis. The technical challenge is considerable.
lines.style: Informative, precise. Two clear segments — first the method, then the weight of difficulty. Steady voice, no rush. Slight respect in the pacing for the ambition involved.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 記録の仮名表記、最新の規則に従って統一しよう。
lines.en: Let's unify the phonetic notation of records under the latest standards.
lines.style: Decisive but not authoritarian. Clear directive given as collaborative instruction. Even tone, purposeful. Assumes competence in the listener.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.style: Brief, clean acknowledgment. Quiet confidence — no elaboration needed. Professional close.
